🏀 GAME 8: BASKETBALL SHOWDOWN

Primo is on the court! Make 5 baskets before the 25-second clock runs out!

🏀 Shoot for the Birthday Win!

In Primo's first-person view, line up the moving aim marker with the green hoop target. Score 5 baskets before 25 seconds run out!

  1. Press SHOOT or the SPACE key while the moving aim marker is over the green target.
  2. Missed shots do not use up a turn. Keep shooting until you score 5 baskets or time runs out.
  3. On your 4th shot the hoop moves left and right.
  4. On your 5th shot the hoop moves up and down.
